descriptor: An intelligent conversational data analytics platform for non-technical and technical users to connect data sources, ask questions, and receive analytical answers.

requirements.statement: The system must allow users to connect to SQL Server databases using secure connection settings.
The system must allow users to upload and analyze CSV files.
The system must provide a conversational interface for users to ask questions in natural language.
The system must interpret user questions and suggest potential interpretations if uncertain.
The system must analyze data to provide accurate, explainable answers to user questions.
The system must allow users to generate visualizations of analytical results with configurable parameters.
The system must generate reports based on analytical results.
The system must allow users to ask follow-up questions without repeating previous context.
The system must support user roles including Business Users, Data Analysts, Data Engineers, and Executives.
The system must provide business-friendly explanations for analytical results.
The system must allow Data Analysts to generate SQL queries from natural language questions.
The system must allow Data Engineers to inspect schemas and profile data.
The system must provide executive summaries and KPIs for Executives.
The system must connect to SQL Server using Windows/Integrated Authentication and SQL Authentication.
The system must encrypt data connections to SQL Server.
The system must detect and handle null values and duplicate records in CSV uploads.
The system must provide alerts and recommendations based on data analysis.
The system must allow users to download reports and dashboards.

releases.demo: Connect to SQL Server and CSV, ask a question, and receive an answer with potential interpretations.
releases.goal: Establish secure data connections and basic query functionality.
releases.name: Initial Data Connection and Query

releases.demo: Analyze data and visualize results with business-friendly explanations.
releases.name: Enhanced Data Analysis and Visualization

releases.demo: Generate reports and allow follow-up questions without losing context.
releases.goal: Improve user experience with context retention and reporting capabilities.
releases.name: User Experience and Reporting

releases.demo: Support multiple user roles and secure data connections.
releases.goal: Implement advanced user roles and secure data handling.
releases.name: Advanced User Roles and Security

releases.demo: Show alerts and recommendations for data insights.
releases.goal: Provide alerts and recommendations based on data analysis.
releases.name: Alerts and Recommendations

stories.title: Establish Initial Data Connection and Query Execution
stories.narrative: As a Data Analyst, I want to connect to the SQL Server Database and execute queries, so that I can retrieve and analyze data.
acceptance: Given a valid SQL Server connection string, when I connect to the database, then I should be able to execute a basic SQL query.
Given an invalid SQL Server connection string, when I attempt to connect, then I should receive an error message indicating the connection failure.
Trust: Every query execution must be logged with the user ID and timestamp.
stories.task_guidance: Use the SQL Server connection string provided in the configuration file to establish a connection. Implement query execution using the SQL client library.

stories.title: Upload and Analyze CSV Files
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to upload CSV files, so that I can analyze the data contained within them.
acceptance: Given a CSV file, when I upload it, then the system should detect columns and datatypes.
Given a CSV file with duplicates, when I upload it, then the system should identify duplicate records.
Trust: All uploads are logged with user details and file metadata.
stories.task_guidance: Use Apache Commons CSV to parse and analyze CSV files, detecting duplicates and nulls.

stories.title: Ask Questions in Natural Language
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to ask questions in natural language, so that I can interact with the system easily.
acceptance: Given a natural language question, when I ask it, then the system should interpret it correctly.
Given an ambiguous question, when I ask it, then the system should suggest potential interpretations.
Trust: All questions and interpretations are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Implement NLP using a pre-trained model like BERT to interpret questions.

stories.title: Visualize Analytical Results
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to visualize analytical results, so that I can understand the data better.
acceptance: Given analytical results, when I request a visualization, then the system should display a chart.
Given a request for a specific chart type, when I request it, then the system should display the correct type.
Trust: All visualizations are logged with user details.
stories.task_guidance: Use D3.js to create interactive visualizations based on analytical results.

stories.title: Provide Business-Friendly Explanations
stories.narrative: As a business user, I want explanations in simple terms, so that I can understand the results without technical knowledge.
acceptance: Given analytical results, when I request an explanation, then the system should provide a business-friendly summary.
Given a complex analysis, when I request an explanation, then the system should simplify the details.
Trust: All explanations are logged with user details.
stories.task_guidance: Implement a summarization algorithm to convert technical results into business language.

stories.title: Generate Reports from Analytical Results
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to generate reports, so that I can share insights with others.
acceptance: Given analytical results, when I request a report, then the system should generate a PDF report.
Given a request for a specific report format, when I request it, then the system should generate the correct format.
Trust: All report generations are logged with user details.
stories.task_guidance: Use Apache PDFBox to generate PDF reports from analytical data.

stories.title: Allow Follow-Up Questions
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to ask follow-up questions, so that I can continue my analysis without starting over.
acceptance: Given a previous question, when I ask a follow-up, then the system should remember the context.
Given a new session, when I ask a follow-up, then the system should prompt for context.
Trust: All follow-up interactions are logged with user details.
stories.task_guidance: Implement session management to retain context across user interactions.

stories.title: Support Multiple User Roles
stories.narrative: As an admin, I want to define user roles, so that users have access to appropriate features.
acceptance: Given a user, when I assign a role, then the user should have access to role-specific features.
Given a role change, when I update it, then the user's access should update accordingly.
Trust: All role assignments are logged with admin details.
stories.task_guidance: Implement role-based access control using Spring Security.

stories.title: Secure Data Connections
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want secure data connections, so that data integrity is maintained.
acceptance: Given a database connection, when I configure it, then the connection should be encrypted.
Given an unencrypted connection attempt, when I detect it, then the system should block it.
Trust: All connection configurations are logged with user details.
stories.task_guidance: Ensure all database connections use SSL/TLS for encryption.

stories.title: Provide Alerts and Recommendations
stories.narrative: As a user, I want alerts and recommendations, so that I can act on data insights.
acceptance: Given data insights, when I request alerts, then the system should notify me of important changes.
Given a recommendation request, when I ask for it, then the system should provide actionable advice.
Trust: All alerts and recommendations are logged with user details.
stories.task_guidance: Implement a rule-based engine to generate alerts and recommendations based on data analysis.

stories.title: Interpret User Questions and Suggest Interpretations
stories.narrative: As a User, I want the system to interpret my questions and suggest potential interpretations, so that I can refine my queries.
acceptance: Given a user question, when the system interprets it, then it should suggest at least one potential interpretation.
Given an ambiguous question, when the system interprets it, then it should suggest multiple interpretations for user selection.
Trust: Every interpretation suggestion must be logged with the question and user ID.
stories.task_guidance: Implement natural language processing to parse user questions and generate interpretations. Log each interpretation attempt.

stories.title: Analyze Data and Provide Explainable Answers
stories.narrative: As a User, I want the system to analyze data and provide accurate, explainable answers to my questions, so that I can understand the results.
acceptance: Given a user question, when the system analyzes data, then it should provide an accurate answer with an explanation.
Given a complex question, when the system analyzes data, then it should provide an answer with a detailed explanation of the analysis process.
Trust: Every answer provided must be logged with the question, answer, and user ID.
stories.task_guidance: Use data analysis algorithms to process queries and generate answers. Ensure explanations are clear and logged.

stories.title: Provide Executive Summaries and KPIs
stories.narrative: As an Executive, I want the system to provide executive summaries and KPIs, so that I can quickly assess business performance.
acceptance: Given a set of data, when I request an executive summary, then the system should provide a concise summary with key KPIs.
Given incomplete data, when I request an executive summary, then the system should indicate missing data and provide available KPIs.
Trust: Every summary request must be logged with the user ID and timestamp.
stories.task_guidance: Design executive summary templates that highlight key KPIs. Implement data aggregation and summary generation.

stories.title: Inspect Schemas and Profile Data
stories.narrative: As a Data Engineer, I want to inspect schemas and profile data, so that I can ensure data quality and structure.
acceptance: Given a database, when I inspect schemas, then I should see the structure and relationships of tables.
Given a dataset, when I profile data, then I should see data distribution and quality metrics.
Trust: Every schema inspection and data profiling must be logged with the user ID and timestamp.
stories.task_guidance: Implement schema inspection tools and data profiling algorithms. Ensure all actions are logged for auditing.
